maddeler.e:
أتواثب (form VI)
# أَتَوَاثَبُ (ʔatawāṯabu) /ʔa.ta.waː.θa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# أَتَوَاثَبَ (ʔatawāṯaba) /ʔa.ta.waː.θa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# أَتَوَاثَبْ (ʔatawāṯab) /ʔa.ta.waː.θab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
